$comment: Evidence registry. Every factual claim rendered on a marketing surface carries data-evidence="<id>" pointing at a row in here. status=pending means the verifier has not been confirmed by the owner and the claim MUST NOT render. verifier is either a URL on an allowlisted host or a path that exists in this repository.

items.claim: Starhold runs on machines I administer: a dedicated server and a VPS joined by a private Tailscale mesh, in rootless Podman containers.
Uptime for the Starhold services is published on a status page anyone can open.
Payments run through live Stripe Checkout, and every incoming webhook signature is verified before anything acts on it.
This storefront ships with unit tests and browser tests; the counts on this site are generated from the repository, not typed in.
Certified in log aggregation at the administration tier.
items.note: Vendor name deliberately omitted - see UNVERIFIED Q6. Attaching a vendor without owner confirmation would be fabrication.

items.claim: By day I keep automation running for an organisation that operates worldwide. The employer is not named here.
Product and operations documentation is written up and published at starhold.fyi.
QNix architecture, hosting, and tenancy/security design notes are written down and published before the product exists.
Kyle Green's professional profile, where the certifications and the current role are listed.
Shushgame is live: a Discord-native game with its own site, its own bot, and its own payments.
The product catalog is published as machine-readable JSON and consumed by the Starhold Discord bot as a contract.
The source for this site, including its tests, is on GitHub.
